blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Nic Cabañero came through with a game-high 15 points, but his offensive effort went unrewarded as Biñan Tatak Gel suffered a 74-54 beating at the hands of Quezon Province in Game 2 of the SportsPlus MPBL (Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League) 2026 Season South Division Finals on Thursday at the Quezon Convention Center in Lucena City. Cabanero, MPBL’s frontrunner for season MVP tried to keep Binan within striking distance, knocking down two triples in the second quarter as the Laguna-based squad threatened to erase an early deficit.
